name: DS Cluster D01: Market Data Source (Primary OHLCV)
description: Tests: market_data_source()() primary OHLCV for study_assets, .o/.h/.l/.c/.v fields, SMA on stock close, volume profile, intrabar range.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D01: Market Data Source
# =============================================================================
# market_data_source()() is the primary OHLCV source for assets in data.assets.
# No options — asset selection is in definition JSON.
# For stocks/ETFs, src.c is directly usable (one row per timestamp).

src = market_data_source()()
open = src.o
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c
vol = src.v

# === MOVING AVERAGES ON CLOSE ===
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# === INTRABAR RANGE (high - low) ===
bar_range = high - low
avg_range = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(bar_range)

# === VOLUME MOVING AVERAGE ===
vol_ma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(vol)
vol_ratio = vol / vol_ma

# === CLOSE-TO-CLOSE RETURNS ===
ret = returns(close)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Close with SMA(20) and SMA(50)",
    category="Price",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 20", color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 50", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, sma_20, sma_50))

xy_lines(
    title="Average True Range (20-bar)",
    category="Price",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Bar Range", color=Color.Yellow),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Avg Range", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(bar_range, avg_range))

xy_lines(
    title="Volume Ratio (vol / 20d MA)",
    category="Volume",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Vol Ratio", color=Color.Green)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title="Average"),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title="2x Avg")
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=vol_ratio)

histogram(
    title="Daily Returns Distribution",
    category="Returns",
    bins=50
)(ret)
